PetFaq2.subtitle: Got Questions?
PetFaq2.description: Here is everything you need to know about our appointments, treatments, hygiene procedures, and hospital policies.

items.question: How do I prepare my pet for their initial wellness consultation?
items.answer: Bring along previous immunization records and any current medications. We recommend arriving a few minutes early so your companion can settle comfortably into our calm lobby environment.

items.question: What companion animals are welcome at Furique?
items.answer: We specialize primarily in dogs and cats of all breeds and ages, with custom handling protocols for anxious or senior pets. Feel free to contact us for specific exotic pet inquiries.

items.question: What takes place during a routine preventive checkup?
items.answer: Our doctors conduct a comprehensive nose-to-tail physical exam covering dental health, eye and ear checks, heart and lung auscultation, weight assessment, and tailored vaccination reviews.

items.question: Why are vaccinations vital even for pets who stay indoors?
items.answer: Airborne pathogens and organisms brought inside on shoes, clothing, or other visitors can still expose indoor pets. Vaccines build reliable immunity against life-threatening illnesses.

items.question: How often should senior pets visit the clinic?
items.answer: Pets aged seven and older benefit greatly from biannual checkups, allowing early detection and proactive management of age-related joint, kidney, and metabolic conditions.

items.question: Do you offer fear-free, low-stress pet grooming?
items.answer: Yes. Our groomers are trained in gentle handling techniques using soothing hypoallergenic shampoos, calm water temperatures, and patient coat care suited to your pet comfort.

items.question: How does your team handle unexpected urgent medical situations?
items.answer: Our critical care staff prioritizes emergencies immediately during clinic hours. We ask that you phone ahead so we can prep our surgical or triage bay before your arrival.

items.question: Can you help design a custom diet and nutritional plan?
items.answer: Absolutely. We analyze your pet activity level, current weight, allergies, and life stage to prescribe balanced whole-food and clinical nutrition regimens.
